title: Dominant For Them, Submissive For Me Hypno
description:

This file is perfect for anyone in a relationship or who has a play partner who wants to be submissive sometimes. A way to get yourself to act in the dominant role without fear or reservation and to still enjoy it as a submissive. The perfect hypno file for anyone who wants to broaden their D/S horizons and break out of that submissive only mindset!
